pillars.label: Loss & revenue
pillars.basis: PFC Integrated Rating, Performance Excellence (billing and collection efficiency, distribution loss vs approved) and RDSS AT&C targets. Company-level finance (ACS-ARR gap, DSCR, subsidy, tariff) is left out: offices do not control it.

pillars.label: Reliability
pillars.basis: CSRD Operational Reliability (45 nationally), weighted down to 15: we have feeder outage logs only, no consumers per feeder and no DT failure register, and CCCs are reached through a feeder-name match to the DT list.

pillars.label: Connection services
pillars.basis: CSRD Connection and Other Services (10 nationally), weighted up to 20: the pending lists for new connections and load extensions and the PM Surya Ghar portal export are complete and current. Timelines are WBERC's binding ones; the 2024 national limits are shown as a stretch reference, not scored.

pillars.label: Metering & billing
pillars.basis: CSRD Metering, Billing and Collection (35 nationally; collection efficiency sits in Loss & revenue here). Bills on actual reading, digital payments, prepaid and SMS coverage have no office-level data and are not scored.

pillars.label: Faults & grievances
pillars.basis: CSRD Fault Rectification and Grievance Redressal (10 nationally). Call-centre items are company-level; closed-docket times stop in June 2025, so open dockets are measured instead.

rules.naParameter: A parameter that cannot be measured at an office (not at this level, no data, stale, too few cases, low coverage) is n/a; its marks go to the other parameters of its pillar in proportion to their marks.
rules.naPillar: If nothing in a pillar can be measured, the pillar's weight goes to the other pillars in proportion to their weights.
rules.minRated: An office is graded only if at least 60 of the 100 base marks can be measured.
rules.penalties: Penalties only subtract (cap −5) and are never applied on stale data.
rules.levels: Each office is computed from its own summed inputs (including rows booked at the office itself, such as HT input at regions), never as an average of its children; ranks are within a level.
rules.ranks: Competition ranking on the score rounded to 2 decimals (equal scores share a rank).

sources.CSRD: REC Consumer Service Rating of DISCOMs, FY21-FY25 (Annex E)
sources.WBERC_SOP: WBERC Standards of Performance, Reg. 46/WBERC (2010) as amended by 57/WBERC (2013) and later
sources.ROC: Electricity (Rights of Consumers) Rules 2020, as amended 2022 and 2024
sources.ZONE: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)

methodology.label: AT&C loss
methodology.formula: 100 × (input − min(collection, billed)) ÷ input, MU, 12 months to the latest month
methodology.sourceText: RDSS Guidelines v7 (MoP, 22.09.2023)
methodology.ref: RDSS 2.1.1 (AT&C 12-15 % target); 3.2.2.2 (divisions above 25 % are priority loss areas)

methodology.label: Distribution loss vs the office target
methodology.formula: distribution loss ÷ the office's target distribution loss (loss_targets)
methodology.sourceText: PFC 14th Integrated Rating, FY 2024-25
methodology.ref: IR14 B1: actual ÷ approved loss, ≤ 1 full, > 1.2 zero; the office target is WBSEDCL's (loss_targets)

methodology.label: Collection efficiency
methodology.formula: 100 × collection ÷ billed, MU (capped at 100 as in the loss sheet)
methodology.sourceText: PFC 14th Integrated Rating, FY 2024-25
methodology.ref: IR14 B3 absolute scale (≥ 99.5 % full, < 91 % zero); RDSS 3.1.5.4(xv) national target ≥ 98 %

methodology.label: Receivables
methodology.formula: OSD of live consumers ÷ average daily collection over 12 months (LT; HT collections at regions excluded)
methodology.sourceText: PFC 14th Integrated Rating, FY 2024-25
methodology.ref: IR14 A2 days receivable (≤ 60 full, > 120 zero), on collection instead of revenue

methodology.label: AT&C loss trend on a year earlier
methodology.formula: 100 × (AT&C now − AT&C a year earlier) ÷ AT&C a year earlier
methodology.sourceText: PFC 14th Integrated Rating, FY 2024-25
methodology.ref: IR14 trajectory marks (1-year improvement better than 5 %); RDSS REM 4.12.8 (no marks if the same or worse)

methodology.label: Supply availability
methodology.formula: 100 × (1 − 12 × outage hours a DT saw per month ÷ 8,760); outages over 5 minutes, 12 report months
methodology.sourceText: WBERC Tariff Regulations 2026 (82/WBERC)
methodology.ref: WBERC Tariff Regs 2026 Reg 96.2 (availability = 1 − SAIDI/8760), 96.3 (norm 98 %), 96.4 (incentive above 98.5 %), 96.5 (maximum disincentive at 96.75 %)

methodology.label: Interruptions per feeder
methodology.formula: 12 × outages over 5 minutes per 11 kV feeder per month, 12 report months
methodology.sourceText: REC Consumer Service Rating of DISCOMs, FY21-FY25 (Annex E)
methodology.ref: CSRD 1.2 interruption index, rural scale (< 60 a year full, > 720 zero)

methodology.label: Paid new connections pending beyond 30 days
methodology.formula: 100 × paid applications pending more than 30 days since payment ÷ paid applications pending
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Timeline: WBERC Reg 4.1 (30 days where the distributing main exists). Scale: zone choice, spanning the CCCs today (quartiles 48 / 64 / 75 %)
methodology.stretch: National limit (Rules 2024, rule 4(11)): 3 days metro, 7 other municipal, 15 rural

methodology.label: Days from payment to work order
methodology.formula: average days from quotation payment to work order, pending applications with a work order
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Zone choice: by 30 days the whole WBERC connection timeline is used up; a week leaves time to build

methodology.label: Load extensions pending 3 months or more
methodology.formula: 100 × load extensions pending 3 months or more ÷ load extensions pending
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Timeline: WBERC Reg 4.2 (57/WBERC), longest LV/MV augmentation 90 days. Scale: zone choice, as for new connections

methodology.label: Rooftop solar installations net-metered
methodology.formula: 100 × PM Surya Ghar installations with a net metering date ÷ installations completed
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Timeline: Rights of Consumers Rules 2020, rule 11 (commissioning within 30 days of the installation certificate). Scale: zone choice; the share counts only the step the office controls (installed → net meter), not vendor or consumer delays

methodology.label: Defective meters
methodology.formula: 100 × defective meters (summary) ÷ live consumers
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Zone choice: WBERC Reg 11 asks for replacement within 7-30 days, so the stock should be small; 5 % is about the best CCC, 35 % is past the worst division

methodology.label: Defective meters older than 5 years
methodology.formula: 100 × defective meters with a defect over 5 years old ÷ defective meters
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Zone choice: a meter defective for 5 years has missed every WBERC timeline; the scale spans the CCCs today

methodology.label: Consumers unbilled for 3 months
methodology.formula: existing consumers unbilled for 3 months ÷ live consumers × 10,000
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: CSRD 3.6 expects every required bill; scale: zone choice spanning the CCCs today

methodology.label: New connections without a first bill
methodology.formula: live connections without a first bill ÷ live consumers × 10,000
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Rights of Consumers Rules 2020, rule 6(7): first bill within two billing cycles. Scale: zone choice

methodology.label: Master cards pending over 30 days
methodology.formula: 100 × master cards pending more than 30 days after meter installation ÷ master cards pending
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Zone choice: a meter installed 30 days ago without a master card misses the first billing cycle (Rules 2020, rule 6(7))

methodology.label: Fault dockets open over 24 hours
methodology.formula: technical dockets open 24 hours or more ÷ live consumers × 10,000
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Timeline: WBERC Reg 9.1 (most faults restored within 24 hours). Scale: zone choice spanning the CCCs today

methodology.label: All dockets still open
methodology.formula: open dockets ÷ live consumers × 10,000
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Zone choice: an open docket is an unresolved complaint as far as the record goes (Rules 2020, rule 14 CRM)

methodology.label: CMO grievances pending with an MZO officer
methodology.formula: 100 × grievances pending with an MZO officer ÷ grievances on the report
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Zone choice; grievances name only the district, so this is scored for regions and the zone

methodology.label: Fatal electrical accidents
methodology.formula: fatal accidents to people in 12 months ÷ live consumers × 1,00,000
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Modelled on IR14 Pillar D (capped disincentives); scale: zone choice, one fatal accident in an average CCC (55,000 consumers) costs about 1.5 marks

methodology.label: Unsafe sites not rectified
methodology.formula: 100 − share of unsafe sites found in safety inspections that are rectified
methodology.sourceText: Zone choice (no national or WBERC benchmark for this office-level measure)
methodology.ref: Modelled on IR14 Pillar D; scale: zone choice
